Hi team — attached are three clean itineraries that meet the 18 Apr by-6pm arrival window:
Option A (lower cost, 1 stop): arrives 15:48 local; non-refundable; $0 change credit except for schedule changes at carrier discretion.
Option B (premium economy, 1 stop, refundable fare class Y): arrives 14:30 local; fully refundable; transferable for a fee.
Option C (business nonstop): arrives 13:15 local; refundable; includes same-day confirmed standby for changes at ticketing desk.

Playbook notes for rebook/standby:
- For non-refundable fares (Option A), airlines frequently issue an electronic travel credit if cancellation is within 24 hrs (depends on carrier). We recommend booking Roberta on Option B refundable hold for 24 hours; if final approval comes, swap to Option A to save cost.
- If we need to use airline credit later: require the original ticket number and carrier credit code; our ops team will file the claim and apply when reissuing.
- Standby process: carriers allow same-day confirmed or standby based on fare class and elite status. We can request same-day confirmed at check-in for an added fee; otherwise standby is possible but not guaranteed.

I'll prepare PNRs once you confirm which option to issue. If you'd like, Redwood can pay up-front and invoice BrightRetail to simplify approvals.

Best,
Monica Patel
Travel Operations Manager | Redwood Inference
